dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: The Guild provides different recommended areas to explore based on your Adventure Rank.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Which rank's Adventure Report would you like to see?

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Go out of the front gates of Mondstadt, pass the bridge, and the steppe you come to would be <color=#00E1FFFF>Windrise</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Alfry
dialogues.text: Any other rank's Adventure Report you'd like to see?
